2607.07219.title: Vision Foundation Models in Radiology: A Scoping Review of Data, Methodology, Evaluation and Clinical Translation
2607.07219.paper_summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly being developed for radiological imaging, yet their definition, development and evaluation remain heterogeneous. We conducted a PRISMAScR scoping review of peer-reviewed studies published between January 2017 and March 2026 describing foundation models trained exclusively on radiological imaging data. Sixty-seven studies were included and mapped across three pillars: data scale and heterogeneity, architectural and pretraining scalability, and downstream transferability and generalization. Datasets primarily covered brain MRI, thoracoabdominal CT, and chest X-ray, ranging from fewer than 100,000 samples to multi-million-image cohorts. Transformer-based architectures and self-supervised pretraining predominated, particularly masked image modeling, contrastive learning and multi-stage approaches. Evaluation focused mainly on segmentation and classification, whereas cross-center, cross-scanner, anatomical and modality-shift validation was inconsistently reported. Alignment with FUTURE-AI principles was uneven. Overall, radiology-specific VFMs show promising transferability, but clinical translation remains constrained by limited data representativeness, heterogeneous benchmarks, incomplete reporting and insufficient deployment-oriented evaluation.
2607.07219.paper_summary_zh: 視覺基礎模型（VFMs）正日益被開發用於放射影像，但其定義、發展和評估仍然不一致。<lb/>我們進行了一項PRISMAScR範疇回顧，對2017年1月至2026年3月期間發表的同行評審研究進行了分析，這些研究描述了專門在放射影像數據上訓練的基礎模型。<lb/>共納入67項研究，並在三個支柱上進行了映射：數據規模和異質性、架構和預訓練的可擴展性，以及下游轉移性和泛化能力。<lb/>數據集主要涵蓋腦部MRI、胸腹部CT和胸部X光，樣本數量從少於100,000個到數百萬影像的隊列不等。<lb/>基於Transformer的架構和自我監督預訓練占主導地位，特別是遮蔽影像建模、對比學習和多階段方法。<lb/>評估主要集中在分割和分類上，而跨中心、跨掃描儀、解剖和模態轉換的驗證報告不一致。<lb/>與FUTURE-AI原則的一致性不均。<lb/>總體而言，針對放射學的VFMs顯示出有希望的轉移能力，但臨床轉化仍受限於數據代表性的不足、異質基準、不完整的報告和不足的部署導向評估。
